card.name: Inside nasogastric and enema words
card.fires_on: The ending piece of 'nasogastric' or 'naso-gastric' (the 'ic' after 'gastr') in instructions for giving a dose through a feeding tube. Also the 'sis' in 'clysis' (enema).

modes.label: Nasogastric tube
modes.description: The 'ic' closing 'nasogastr-ic' in tube administration directions.
modes.example: Administration via Nasogastr<<ic>> Tube 1. Open the esome

modes.label: Enema volume
modes.description: The 'sis' ending 'clysis' in a statement about enema volume for young children.
modes.example: . For infants and children less than 3 years old, the volume of a single cly<<sis>> should be limited to 200

card.plain: It marks the end of the word nasogastric when a label explains giving a drug through a feeding tube.
